summary: The first-time player successfully follows the initial shard-gathering loop, but struggles with off-screen tutorial targets, ambiguous upgrade pad icons, and a lack of clear goals once free-roam gameplay begins. Additionally, the playable runs for over 90 seconds without ever presenting an end card or CTA.

items.title: Post-tutorial upgrade pads and objectives are ambiguous
items.evidence: From t=40.2s to 88.7s, clarity drops to 23%–48% as the player navigates between the 40 (pickaxe), 50 (crystal), and 1,500 (tower) pads while a yellow arrow points to the crystal pile. The player steps on pads without clear feedback on whether they can afford them or what the overarching goal is.
items.suggestion: Add a persistent top HUD showing current gold, a clear objective tracker (e.g., 'Hire 2 Workers' or 'Unlock the Tower: 49/1500'), and color-code upgrade pad costs (red when unaffordable, green/pulsing when affordable).

items.title: No end card or CTA within 92 seconds of play
items.evidence: The session ran for 91.8s and ended by time_limit without ever triggering an end card or install prompt.
items.suggestion: Trigger the end card with a clear 'Play Now' CTA after a key milestone—such as hiring the second worker or upgrading the mine (around 45–60s)—rather than waiting for the 1,500-gold tower.

items.title: Tutorial hand points off-screen toward hidden upgrade pad
items.evidence: At t=22.8s, the player is at the golden carpet with 46 gold and the tutorial hand points left-downward into empty courtyard space. The player has to walk around the stone building until t=34.2s before the '10' pickaxe pad becomes visible.
items.suggestion: Place an on-screen edge indicator or briefly pan the camera to the '10' pickaxe pad when it becomes the active tutorial step so the player sees their destination immediately.

items.title: Initial tap input fails to move character or clarify drag control
items.evidence: At t=0.5s–1.6s, the tutorial hand points to a yellow circle without showing a drag motion, and at t=4.5s the player's input has no visible effect while 'DRAG TO MOVE' is displayed.
items.suggestion: Animate the tutorial hand performing a clear drag gesture with a visible virtual joystick ring, and show a subtle joystick indicator on any tap so players immediately understand they need to hold and drag.
